speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand what's going on, can you tell me your age and how old you are? I also need to know if you have had any recent infections or exposures to chemicals or radiation.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does she have any swelling or enlargement of her abdomen, neck, or armpits that might suggest swollen lymph nodes or an enlarged spleen? I also need to know if she has had any bone pain elsewhere or if the bruising is widespread.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't answered my previous questions about swelling in the abdomen, neck, or armpits. Can you tell me if she has any palpable lumps or an enlarged belly? Also, has she had any nosebleeds or bleeding from the gums?
